task_title: Overhaul primary stats and remove mana

plan_review.notes: Two pre-edit rounds considered a dual-store adapter, source-resolved damage, persisted attack payloads, parallel versus inline output metadata, mana neutering, and a scope split. The revised plan made a load-bearing fork to one EffectiveStats read lane plus attack-creation snapshots of fail-closed affinity/scaling metadata; it also adopted inline explicit outputs, a legacy modifier remap, authored spell bases, safe cadence bounds, spawn HP seeding, status-speed ordering, synthetic weight tests, and INT parity. Rejected the PR split and weapon/enemy retuning because the approved contract requires one PR and permits only stat constants/default allocator tuning.
